hypothesis: The C52-passing dense value expert improves candidate0 continuations when tested on wholly new visual sources at the same d3/d5-before-parent-success state distribution used by C52.
single_variable: At each frozen new source state, control executes offset0 for32 steps while candidate selects one of offsets 0, 1000000, 2000000 and 3000000 once; both then use identical replan8 continuation seeds.
parent_baseline: D0-H32-s14000/replan8/sample1 on trials29..32, which did not exist during C50-C53.
diagnostic_reason: C53 intervened at fixed step80 whereas C52 evidence came from d3/d5 before successful termination; C54 tests this pre-existing state-distribution mismatch without tuning on C53 outcomes.

source_contract.eligible: successful parent with both d3 and d5 replan rows

source_gate.selection: all eligible sources, both d3 and d5; no outcome-based subsampling

effect_gate.mechanical: bit-exact start state, candidate0 action, continuation seeds, ranker identity and score variation
effect_gate.suite_safety: no suite success rate regresses by >0.05

decision.on_pass: Conclude dense value works only with state-aligned triggering and develop a deployable progress trigger before benchmark expansion.
decision.on_fail: Reject online use and treat C52 as source-reuse-limited offline evidence.
